note: WIST-1 sections 3.2, 5.1 and 5.2. Authenticated hourly Declaration histories open recovery at height 1 after a same-Epoch ordinary predecessor, accept a competitor and a legitimate follower, accept a higher-sequence competitor at 168, settle at 169, then apply a scope-removing Declaration in that same deadline Epoch. Height 170 grants scopes again. Admission and sealing probes run after the named Epoch's Declaration stage; settlement probes run immediately before height 169's Declaration stage. Queued-copy probes reuse height-1 authority-eligible Envelopes; damaged settlement probes are conditional stage inputs and do not claim prior queue acceptance. accepted establishes only signature/binding and scope authority. Probe timestamps are signed inputs, not claimed live validation times. Chains, clocks, Payload, quotas, durable queue/status effects and actual Delta inclusion are not exercised. Trusted Log key and pinned heads are fixture inputs. Signature-invalid twins are checked independently by the reference.
